The name is fine, but whether it's the better choice depends on your taste, not on me.

Odyssey has strong associations with a famous epic cycle and a long journey full of adventures. For a sailboat, that's a fitting metaphor. The main weakness is that it's also a very popular name for boats, so it's less distinctive.

Common alternatives are things like Machi or Wendolene or a two-word phrase, but the right name is the one you like the sound of every time you check in at the dock.

If you want a quick recommendation, pick whichever name you'd happily yell across a crowded marina. If you'd be proud to say 'This is Odyssey,' then Odyssey is good.
